title: Flaky Test Prevention Checklist — Runnable Companion
title_es: Checklist de Prevención de Tests Flaky — Companion Ejecutable
description: Runnable companion for the flaky test prevention checklist: a Playwright auto-waiting spec (the anti-sleep pattern), a repeat-until-failure loop script that proves determinism, and a quarantine workflow template with SLA.
description_es: Companion ejecutable del checklist anti-flaky: un spec de Playwright con auto-waiting (el patrón anti-sleep), un script loop que corre un spec hasta que falla para probar determinismo, y una plantilla de workflow de cuarentena con SLA.
